definitions.explanation: Fine granular material found on beaches, in deserts, and riverbeds. Made of tiny particles of rock and minerals.

examples.japanese: {砂浜|すなはま}の{砂|すな}は{熱|あつ}いです。
examples.english: The sand on the beach is hot.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}が{砂|すな}で{遊|あそ}んでいます。
examples.english: The children are playing in the sand.

examples.japanese: {靴|くつ}の{中|なか}に{砂|すな}が{入|はい}りました。
{公園|こうえん}の{砂場|すなば}で{子供|こども}たちが{遊|あそ}んでいます。
examples.english: Children are playing in the sandbox at the park.

examples.japanese: {海|うみ}から{帰|かえ}ったら、{体|からだ}についた{砂|すな}をよく{洗|あら}ってください。
examples.english: When you come back from the beach, please wash off the sand on your body well.

notes:
Related words:
- {砂浜|すなはま} (sandy beach)
- {砂漠|さばく} (desert)
- {砂場|すなば} (sandbox). The kanji {砂|すな} is also used in {砂糖|さとう} (sugar).
